mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_task_trigger (id, org_id, project_id, name, trigger_type, cron_expression, timezone, event_type, event_filter, webhook_secret_cipher, concurrency_policy, missed_policy, task_template, trigger_version, model_profile_id, prompt_template_id, environment_profile_id, credential_reference_id, runner_type, required_capabilities, policy_json, evidence_policy_json, notification_policy_json, responsible_user_ids, enabled, next_fire_at, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, version) VALUES (#{id}, #{organizationId}, #{projectId}, #{name}, #{triggerType}, #{cronExpression}, #{timezone}, #{eventType}, #{eventFilter}, #{webhookSecretCipher}, #{concurrencyPolicy}, #{missedPolicy}, #{taskTemplate}, #{triggerVersion}, #{modelProfileId}, #{promptTemplateId}, #{environmentProfileId}, #{credentialReferenceId}, #{runnerType}, #{requiredCapabilities}, #{policyJson}, #{evidencePolicyJson}, #{notificationPolicyJson}, #{responsibleUserIds}, #{enabled}, #{nextFireAt}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedAt}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_task_trigger WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
